name: MCP contract (any client)
content:
## MCP contract (any client)

The hub MCP server and project HTTP API share one origin. Transport, tool inventory, protocol methods, and write semantics are documented in `doc-12`.

- Every MCP tool call requires an explicit `project` argument. On this run the project id is `{{project.id}}` (also stamped in your task preamble).
- Reads return a `conflict_token`. Pass the most recent token on every write. A stale token returns 409 with the current entity in the body; re-read and retry.
- Read `see:/projects/{{project.id}}/stories/config` for valid story statuses and label conventions instead of hardcoding them.
- Read `see:/projects/{{project.id}}/workspace-layout` when a task needs path-root rules.
- Peers below MCP protocol `2026-07-28` receive the full `tools/list` catalog in one response; `2026-07-28` and newer receive paged listings with `nextCursor` (story-58). When your client negotiates a modern version, walk every page until `nextCursor` is absent.
- `initialize` on this hub returns `serverInfo.name` `s-e-e-mcp` with the workspace package version, not the rmcp SDK name (story-59).
